schema.description: Notificações | Para que a sua plataforma se mantenha sempre atualizada a Webmania disponibiliza as notificações automáticas para todos os status da Nota Fiscal . | Cada Nota Fiscal possui um número único de identificação chamado de UUID , este número deve ser utilizado para recepcionar e identificar a Nota Fiscal para atualizar as informações no seu banco de dados . A chave da nota fiscal pode sofrer alterações quando emitida em ambiente de contingência. | O que é o UUID? O UUID ( Universally Unique Identifier ) é um identificador único de 36 caracteres, no formato 8-4-4-4-12 , que a Webmania atribui a cada Nota Fiscal. | Ele é gerado assim que a requisição é recebida com sucesso pela nossa API , ou seja, após passar pelas nossas validações e antes de qualquer transmissão à Sefaz . Por isso o UUID existe independentemente do status da Nota Fiscal na Sefaz — vale para processamento , aprovado , reprovado , denegado , cancelado e contingencia . | Uma vez gerado, o UUID é definitivo : não muda em retentativas, contingência, EPEC ou reenvio. A chave de acesso é um campo diferente e pode mudar — por isso o UUID, e não a chave, deve ser a sua referência no banco de dados. | No momento que realizado a emissão da Nota Fiscal, caso tenha informado o parâmetro url_notificacao , será enviado o retorno no formato POST para a URL especificada contendo no corpo os parâmetros uuid , status , motivo , nfe , serie , recibo , chave , xml , danfe , log e data .

x-conditional-rules: NF-e55 uses modelo1; NFC-e65 uses modelo2. Fields marked unavailable for NFC-e remain unavailable by fiscal model, not silently ignored by the SDK.
For finalidade5/tipo_credito6, each product requires dfe_referenciado.chave and item; nfe_referenciada is prohibited. Other credit/debit variants have date/author/reference eligibility rules.
Customer requirements differ for domestic CPF, domestic CNPJ, foreign person and optional NFC-e recipient. A complete valid recipient requires the matching identity and address group.
Importation/exportation fields augment product objects; rastro is required for regulated medicine/product situations.

Tax class and explicit product impostos are alternative configuration mechanisms subject to server fallback rules. Dynamic CST/classification tables and issuer/destination/scenario determine tax requiredness.
Payment sibling arrays must describe corresponding installments/tenders in equal order. valor_pagamento is required for cash and provider/model-specific cases.
Dates, alphanumeric IDs, government purchases and fiscal reform subgroups depend on provider/environment/date capability. Do not infer availability from the schema alone.
modelo also accepts the string aliases nfe/nfce, and duplicatas is accepted as an alias of parcelas. The responsavel_tecnico group is not yet part of the published documentation table.

schema.description: Explicit known field groups from the public API documentation. Additional fields and exact decimal strings are preserved. Conditional/provider/catalog rules remain server-owned and are identified individually; this schema does not claim complete business-rule validation.
x-conditional-notes: modelo selects cte or cte_os. CT-e OS uses service types 6/7/8, requires the proper taker and supports only its valid events/modalities; do not apply normal CT-e combinations automatically.
CT-e finalidade is 0 normal, 1 value complement, 3 replacement; it differs from the NF-e convention.
All six transport-mode groups and document references, delivery, tax, IBS/CBS and linked-payment groups are modeled. Runtime business/conditional validation remains server-owned.
CT-e OS road transport uses taf_cte_os/registro_estadual_cte_os and its own vehicle/owner data. Normal CT-e road transport uses RNTRC and collection orders.
data_emissao accepts normalized local/ISO dates in America/Sao_Paulo; future tolerance 5 minutes, maximum backdate 168 hours minus 10 minutes transport margin.
For road CT-e OS, interstate national UF pairs require 12 digit TAF; other road operations require the state registration. A configured company value can satisfy the field when the request omits it.
Simplified issuance and delivery confirmation/cancellation are normal CT-e only; do not route CT-e OS through those named methods.

x-conditional-notes: modelo selects cte or cte_os. CT-e OS uses service types 6/7/8, requires the proper taker and supports only its valid events/modalities; do not apply normal CT-e combinations automatically.
CT-e finalidade is 0 normal, 1 value complement, 3 replacement; it differs from the NF-e convention.
All six transport-mode groups and document references, delivery, tax, IBS/CBS and linked-payment groups are modeled. Runtime business/conditional validation remains server-owned.
CT-e OS road transport uses taf_cte_os/registro_estadual_cte_os and its own vehicle/owner data. Normal CT-e road transport uses RNTRC and collection orders.
data_emissao accepts normalized local/ISO dates in America/Sao_Paulo; future tolerance 5 minutes, maximum backdate 168 hours minus 10 minutes transport margin.
For road CT-e OS, interstate national UF pairs require 12 digit TAF; other road operations require the state registration. A configured company value can satisfy the field when the request omits it.
Simplified issuance and delivery confirmation/cancellation are normal CT-e only; do not route CT-e OS through those named methods.

schema.description: The API can return a functional error in HTTP 200. A present error property is always failure. Redact all service credentials and preserve HTTP status.

Map from dotted public field paths to requirement labels, including obrigatorio,obrigatorio_pf,obrigatorio_pj,opcional. Additional future labels/fields are preserved; not all providers return this map.

Company/provider capabilities. Successful status=true does not authorize issuing without checking the returned environment/authentication/model/function support. Error status=false responses are functional errors, not a successful capability lookup.

The current service always probes the production SEFAZ environment. Operational=true returns HTTP 200; operational=false returns HTTP 503, preserving the body as failure context. A configured A1 certificate and eligible NFCom subscription are required.

schema.description: POST search is read-only unless relatorio is supplied (creates/queues an export). Flat filters win over promoted nested filters. General nested filters are promoted first, then model filters fill absent keys. ordenar_por/ordem are top-level controls and are never promoted. Public docs require modelo; the API also supports cross-model searches without model-specific filters, so this contract keeps modelo optional and requires it for model filters/report. Numeric bounds apply equally to numeric strings.

x-conditional-rules: Model-specific flat fields require modelo; irrelevant flat fields may be excluded by server validation. Nested filtros_modelo rejects keys not allowed for that model.
For NFSe the server maps serie/numero to serie_rps/numero_rps when explicit RPS fields are absent. Use explicit RPS names to avoid conflicting pairs.
For received NF-e manifestacao filters apply; other models may ignore them.
documentos selects between 1 and 1000 document UUIDs for exports; an empty array is invalid, never equivalent to all documents.
Cursor is opaque and must not be decoded/edited. paginacao=cursor selects cursor mode; cursor presence selects it unless offset is explicitly requested.
Sending relatorio creates asynchronous report state and is not a read-only test. Do not retry report generation silently.

schema.description: Explicit known field groups from the public API documentation. Additional fields and exact decimal strings are preserved. Conditional/provider/catalog rules remain server-owned and are identified individually; this schema does not claim complete business-rule validation.
x-conditional-notes: Where the public documentation lists definitions twice, the subscriber/client/item/billing/substitution/co-billing definitions shown on the NFCom page take precedence.

Known groups include subscriber and contract, client/address, items/classification/taxes, invoice, XML authorizations, substitution/model 21/22 references, centralized/co-billing, linked payment and both document/item IBS/CBS groups.
Contract is required for normal/centralized billing and must not be sent for co-billing; validate the current type_faturamento/provider rules.
Issuer request data indicators are optional when false; the API accepts explicit 1 for pre-paid/network-cession/entry flags, so omit an inactive flag instead of assuming numeric 0 is accepted.
previa_danfecom=true generates a preview, not a fiscal authorization; it can still create a temporary preview artifact.
Normal/centralized billing requires subscriber contract number,start date,end date.
fatura.competencia_fatura is AAAAMM with a 20XX year and valid 01-12 month.
Item classification must be supplied at item.codigo_classificacao, item.impostos.codigo_classificacao or a valid classe_imposto. Without a tax class, supplied taxes need at least ICMS,PIS or COFINS.

Government-purchase ente/reduction/operation triples at item level must match across all items unless consolidated at root. For operation 2 only one distinct referenced fiscal key is accepted across the document.

schema.description: Explicit known field groups from the public API documentation. Additional fields and exact decimal strings are preserved. Conditional/provider/catalog rules remain server-owned and are identified individually; this schema does not claim complete business-rule validation.
x-conditional-notes: Where the public documentation lists definitions twice, the subscriber/client/item/billing/substitution/co-billing definitions shown on the NFCom page take precedence.

Known groups include subscriber and contract, client/address, items/classification/taxes, invoice, XML authorizations, substitution/model 21/22 references, centralized/co-billing, linked payment and both document/item IBS/CBS groups.
Contract is required for normal/centralized billing and must not be sent for co-billing; validate the current type_faturamento/provider rules.
Issuer request data indicators are optional when false; the API accepts explicit 1 for pre-paid/network-cession/entry flags, so omit an inactive flag instead of assuming numeric 0 is accepted.
previa_danfecom=true generates a preview, not a fiscal authorization; it can still create a temporary preview artifact.
Normal/centralized billing requires subscriber contract number,start date,end date.
fatura.competencia_fatura is AAAAMM with a 20XX year and valid 01-12 month.
Item classification must be supplied at item.codigo_classificacao, item.impostos.codigo_classificacao or a valid classe_imposto. Without a tax class, supplied taxes need at least ICMS,PIS or COFINS.

Government-purchase ente/reduction/operation triples at item level must match across all items unless consolidated at root. For operation 2 only one distinct referenced fiscal key is accepted across the document.

schema.description: The API can return a functional error in HTTP 200. A present error property is always failure. Redact all service credentials and preserve HTTP status.

Map from dotted public field paths to requirement labels, including obrigatorio,obrigatorio_pf,obrigatorio_pj,opcional. Additional future labels/fields are preserved; not all providers return this map.

Company/provider capabilities. Successful status=true does not authorize issuing without checking the returned environment/authentication/model/function support. Error status=false responses are functional errors, not a successful capability lookup.

The current service always probes the production SEFAZ environment. Operational=true returns HTTP 200; operational=false returns HTTP 503, preserving the body as failure context. A configured A1 certificate and eligible NFCom subscription are required.
